== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]] (<code>1261_105</code>, Virtual Block 6 slip 95), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-95-Odin_Nesloor_First_Aid.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-odinnesloor&firstaid-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Virtual Block 6)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If your character’s forfeit was just reduced to 0, use 1 Force (free if forfeit reduced by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to restore it to normal. [Immune to Sense] OR Cancel an attempt to ‘operate’ on a character; character is protected from any further attempts until start of opponent’s next turn. OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to ‘transport’ (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to ‘transport,’ or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1261_105</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 6 set mark, slip number 95 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-95-Odin_Nesloor_First_Aid-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B10 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
